description: The model lanes one evolution cycle may use, and the budget it must stay inside. Read by scripts/lane.py. The lane ids mirror the model routing policy in the owner's agent configuration, which pins five models and forbids substitution or cross-model fallback; if the two disagree, the policy wins and this file is wrong.

stub.purpose: Tests and dry runs. Reads a fixture response from disk and never touches the network. Every --self-test case uses this lane, which is why the suite needs no credentials.

grok-4.6.purpose: Default lane for a real cycle. Volume work and long context, which is the shape of a 30 day window over the skill tree.

glm-5.3-flash.purpose: Vision and multimodal. Available for a cycle that needs an image or a PDF read.

deepseek-v4.1-flash.purpose: Hard reasoning and planning. Available when a cycle's candidates need adjudication rather than generation.

union-alpha.purpose: Zero cost overflow for bulk generation.

limits.reason: Free and rate limited, so it is permitted for batch generation and not for interactive work. It is a stealth test model and can disappear without notice, so it must never be the only route for anything.

gpt-6-astra.purpose: Expensive review only, after a human has read the candidates.
gpt-6-astra.authorisation_note: The adapter refuses this lane unless the current cycle explicitly names it and the owner has authorised that use. It is never a default and never selected automatically.

forbidden.any_lane_not_listed_above: An unlisted lane is a policy violation, not a configuration gap. lane.py exits 2 rather than falling back.
forbidden.cross_model_fallback: A route may fall back to another subscription serving the SAME model. It may never reroute to a different model, because a result produced by a different model than the one recorded is unattributable.
